data.name: CommandSaveHeader
data.value: Be careful when updating this file :) For keys, use https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/KeyCode.html Colors are stored as an array of 'RGBA' floats

data.name: CommandStatusTextFormat
data.comment: Feature name, status, optional toggle text if a key is set

data.name: FeatureAutomaticGunDescription
data.value: Force all guns (even bolt action guns) to use automatic firing mode with customizable fire rate.

data.name: FeatureCameraDescription
data.value: Free camera with fast mode and teleportation.

data.name: FeatureCrosshairDescription
data.value: Crosshair with customizable size, color, thickness and auto-hide feature when aiming.

data.name: FeatureExamineDescription
data.value: All items already examined. Instant search.

data.name: FeatureExfiltrationPointsDescription
data.value: Exfiltration points with customizable colors given eligibility, status filter, distance.

data.name: FeatureFeatureWallShootDescription
data.value: Shoot through wall/helmet/vest/material with maximum penetration and minimal deviation/ricochet.

data.name: FeatureGameStateDescription
data.value: Refresh all game information for other features.

data.name: FeatureHealthDescription
data.value: Full health, prevent any damage (so even when falling), keep energy and hydration at maximum.

data.name: FeatureHitsDescription
data.value: Hit markers (hit, armor, health with configurable colors).

data.name: FeatureHudDescription
data.value: HUD (compass, ammo left in chamber / magazine, fire mode, coordinates).

data.name: FeatureHudWeaponFormat
data.comment: Magazine count, chamber count, magazine capacity, fire-mode

data.name: FeatureLootItemsDescription
data.value: List all lootable items and track any item by name or rarity or in-game wishlist in raid (even in containers and corpses). Use track and tracklist commands to control display.

data.name: FeatureMapDescription
data.value: Full screen map with radar esp.

data.name: FeatureNoCollisionDescription
data.value: No physical collisions, making you immune to bullets, grenades and barbed wires.

data.name: FeatureNoMalfunctionsDescription
data.value: No weapon malfunctions: no misfires or failures to eject or feed. No jammed bolts or overheating.

data.name: FeatureNoVisorDescription
data.value: No visor, so even when using a face shield-visor you won't see it.

data.name: FeaturePlayersDescription
data.value: Players (you'll see Bear/Boss/Cultist/Scav/Usec with configurable colors through walls). Charms, boxes, info (weapon and health), skeletons and distance.

data.name: FeaturePointOfInterestsFormat
data.comment: Name, optional formatted owner, optional formatted distance

data.name: FeatureQuestsDescription
data.value: Locations for taking/placing quest items. Only items related to your started quests are displayed.

data.name: FeatureSkillsDescription
data.value: All skills to Elite level (51) and all weapons mastering to level 3.

data.name: FeatureSpeedDescription
data.value: Speed boost to be able to go through walls/objects, or to move faster. Be careful to not kill yourself.

data.name: FeatureStashDescription
data.value: Hidden/special stashes like buried barrels, ground caches, air drops or corpses.

data.name: FeatureTrainDescription
data.value: Summon train on compatible maps like Reserve or Lighthouse.

data.name: FeatureNoFlashDescription
data.value: No persistent flash or eye-burn effect after a flash grenade.

data.name: FeatureMortarDescription
data.value: Triggers a mortar strike at the player's location.

data.name: FeatureAirDropDescription
data.value: Triggers an airdrop at the player's location.
